title: 港股11月6日收评：恒指跌1.27%，恒生科技跌1.83%，AI硬件与存储概念股领跌
summary: 受美股AI芯片崩盘延续效应，港股今日全线承压。恒生指数收跌1.27%，报24481点；恒生科技指数跌1.83%。存储概念（南方两倍做多海力士跌超19%）、AI算力（中芯国际跌4.5%、腾讯跌1.8%）均大幅下挫，市场情绪偏弱。
why: AI监管担忧蔓延全球，港股持仓个股今日全线受压，高波动率环境下Sell Put仓位需关注行权价安全边际

title: 美股AI科技股全线崩盘：纳指跌5.52%，标普跌4.36%，费城半导体指数跌12.3%
summary: 11月5日，美股遭遇年内最大单日跌幅之一。纳指跌5.52%、标普500跌4.36%、道指跌3.44%，费城半导体指数重挫12.3%。导火索为民主党在中期选举中夺得国会参众两院，市场担忧数据中心监管收紧及AI资本开支放缓，英伟达跌9.3%拖累全球AI硬件股。
why: 美股AI硬件板块深度回调，大盘波动率骤升；持有AI科技标的的Sell Put策略需关注Delta/Gamma敞口风险，英伟达跌9.3%

title: 2026美国中期选举：民主党夺回参众两院，蓝色浪潮引发科技监管与AI政策不确定性
summary: 美联社宣布民主党同时夺得参众两院控制权，参议院民主党（含独立派）达52席以上，众议院民主党领袖Jeffries有望成为首位非裔议长。市场将此结果解读为AI数据中心建设监管收紧及加密货币立法（CLARITY Act）前景不明的信号。
why: 政策风险重定价：民主党控国会将影响AI算力投资、数据中心监管及稳定币法案走向，对科技赛道（Circle/CRCL、AI平台）整体持仓构成政策不确定性

title: October jobs report preview: US payrolls expected at +65K as labor market continues to cool
summary: The US Bureau of Labor Statistics releases October nonfarm payrolls today (Nov. 6). Bloomberg survey consensus is +65K, while Dow Jones consensus is +59K; unemployment forecast steady at 4.2%. September payrolls came in at only +29K vs ~+90K expected. Average payroll growth since Jan 2025 has been just ~35K/month.
why: 今日非农就业数据若再次大幅低于预期，将加重经济放缓担忧，Fed利率路径重定价；对期权隐含波动率和sell put行权价设置有直接影响

title: Nvidia chips pile up in Hong Kong as China withholds import approval for H200s
summary: About 600,000 Nvidia H200 chips are sitting in Hong Kong storage while Beijing withholds approval for large-scale imports, per Reuters sources. Beijing reportedly wants major Chinese tech firms (Alibaba, ByteDance, Tencent, DeepSeek) to prioritize domestic chips for inference; total approved foreign chip imports may stay under 200,000. H200 servers reportedly trade at over RMB 6 million on the mainland black market.
why: 中国AI供应链出现重大堵点，对英伟达中国收入预期构成压制；中芯国际等国产芯片股可能受益；港股AI算力板块情绪面受冲击；正值11月17日英伟达Q3财报前夕

title: Tencent says its Hy4 joins 'top-tier' of open-source AI models
summary: Tencent launched Hy4, a 770B-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model that activates 49B parameters per token, with a context window over 1 million tokens. Tencent positions Hy4 for coding, office work, and research, claiming it outperforms GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3 in internal benchmarks. The model ships under Apache 2.0 and is available via Tencent Cloud TokenHub and OpenRouter.
why: 腾讯Hy4正式发布巩固云业务AI生态，增强腾讯云竞争力；正值港股AI板块普跌，消息面构成基本面支撑；关注云收入加速变现潜力，对0700.HK长仓有正面意义

title: Palantir Q3 2026 beats estimates: Revenue +96% YoY to $2.31B; US commercial tops government for first time
summary: Palantir reported Q3 2026 EPS of $0.44 (vs $0.41 consensus) and revenue of $2.31B (vs $2.18B estimate), up 96% YoY. GAAP net income was $1.128B (49% margin). US commercial revenue surpassed US government revenue for the first time. Full-year 2026 revenue guidance raised to $8.53B. Despite the strong beat, shares fell amid broader AI sector selling pressure following the midterm results.
why: 延续报道：Q3超预期但股价下跌，表明AI监管担忧盖过业绩支撑；US商业收入首超政府是重要里程碑，AIP平台商业化验证；叠加11月5日大跌，关注PLTR持仓波动率变化与sell put行权价评估
